hints.title: Exploit Four-Quadrant Symmetry
hints.text: Because moves are completely symmetric across axes, map target coordinates to their absolute values in the first quadrant.

hints.title: Base Cases Near the Origin
hints.text: Small coordinates require special base values: (0,0) is 0, (1,0) is 3 moves, and (1,1) or (2,0) require 2 moves.

hints.title: Greedy Recursive Step
hints.text: From (x, y), recursively step toward the origin using either (x - 1, y - 2) or (x - 2, y - 1) with cached results.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded breadth search on an infinite grid explodes with branching factor up to eight.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Restricting search to the positive quadrant with memoization bounds the visited state count tightly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize quadrant symmetry and handle unusual shortest paths near the origin.
complexity.notes: Base cases (1,0) taking 3 moves and (1,1) taking 2 moves must be hardcoded or checked carefully.
